description.value:
From Dragon's Dream · Price: it tells luck for both sides, so enemies can benefit too.

Theme Fate

  • 1: 1 action: learn your lucky direction: you, your stand and allies within 30 ft gain +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves until the start of your next turn.
  • 5: Surge: you know which squares within 30 ft are unlucky for enemies (–2 status to their attacks from them). Lucky and unlucky areas last 1 minute.
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: No change.
  • 17: +2 status for luck.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.rcxplPBSHZ4B8vQ1]{Effect: Lucky Direction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.mohYOsFw6SAmm5QG]{Effect: Unlucky Square}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
